title: RecentPage
description: Planned shape for a future recent-history paging endpoint: one page of recent rows (same row shape as queue_snapshot().recent) plus a next-page cursor. No endpoint exists yet; schema only, enforced by tests/test_admin_contract.py once the endpoint lands.

status.$comment: CLOSE_STATUSES in src/egress_store.py; recent rows are decided (closed) rows.

scope.$comment: Allow scopes ('live','manifest') in _close_request plus VALID_DECIDE_SCOPES ('once','bottle','global') in src/egress_denylist.py; null when never set.

decided_by.$comment: decided_by values written in src/egress_broker_host.py: /decide handler ('operator'/'ntfy'), sweep_stale ('sweep'), _denylist_short_circuit ('denylist').

apply_status.$comment: APPLY_OUTCOMES in src/egress_store.py; null when no allow was attempted.
